notes: New component: App framework step 7 (issue #353). Load and Save are callback properties (business logic) and need JS interop from the component, left for the Blazor page-type step (#346 step 20), same as PkToolPage's Run. Blazor already has the same page concept as PkRecordForm (a PkForm with a toolbar, error alert and a PkDetailLayout sidebar, with the state kept by the page or PkRecordEditor, and ActionsInHeader for the sticky title bar); PkRecordPage is the config-driven element, PkRecordForm stays the composable Razor template.
